title: Hinomori Shizuku — Brand New Style〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Alright, let's start choosing our committees.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I know work keeps you all very busy, but these committees provide a valuable opportunity for you to interact with your juniors.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I would like to see you all do that during your third and final year here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, Airi, you're not going to be on any committees?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm thinking that I shouldn't if I don't have to.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
There's that.
But I also want to spend what time I can at my club.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I understand that it's important to be an active participant at school, but I believe we're all free to enjoy our life as students however we like.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Minori, you're staying on the animal caretaker committee, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, but I plan on having the other committee members fill in for me whenever I'm gone for work.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The teacher even said to not cause your fellow committee members too much trouble when you went over to ask about this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I see. You're showing so much initiative, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Being on the cleanup committee had been a lot of fun. If possible, I'd like to at least continue being a part of some committee.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I just hope that I can make the same arrangement as Minori and not cause the other members too much trouble...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The library committee... No, that involves lending out books during lunch and helping keep all the shelves sorted.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I should be able to make the cleanup committee work since I somehow managed last year...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But this could also be my chance to be on a different committee...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um, excuse me... I have a question.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really? You're going to be on the health committee, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The health committee... So, does that mean you're going to help students get to the nurse when they're not feeling well?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I'll also be responsible for refilling the soap around the sinks and helping take measurements during checkups.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was somewhat interested in joining the broadcasting committee or being a class representative, but I wanted to join a committee that I'm more certain I can make the time for.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which is why you chose the health committee. I actually think it suits you the most, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Anyone who's not feeling well is gonna immediately feel better after you rub their back and tell them that they're gonna be okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm certain!
I mean, just think about it!

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
I don't feel so good...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Oh dear.
Would any health committee members mind taking their classmate over to see the nurse?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How are you feeling? Do you feel nauseous at all...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'll take you to the nurse.
Can you stand? It's okay, take your time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But people who aren't used to being pampered by someone so beautiful might just pass out.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But as a member of the health committee, I don't mind staying with a person for as long as they need if it means them feeling better in the end.
